note: Candidate news sources worldwide. A source may declare localZone, the zone its publisher writes in, when its feed omits it (the reader then reads unzoned times in it, and a day without a time as the end of that day); without it the reader stays strict. Listing a source here does nothing: the owner enables it (scripts/world-news.mjs enable <id> --yes), which first probes the feed with the organisation's own strict reader, then registers and approves the source and writes its feed configuration. Tier 1 is an official body (central bank, regulator, statistics office); tier 2 a publisher. Official sources come first: they are the primary record and the least likely to block automated reading. 'checked' is the day the feed was last read and found current; it is not a promise it still works. Usage stays headlines and summaries with links, for paper research.

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India — press releases
sources.zoneNote: The RBI writes its times without a zone ('Thu, 29 Oct 2026 12:05:00'); they are Indian time.

sources.name: SEBI — news and orders
sources.zoneNote: SEBI's items carry a day without a time ('28 Oct, 2026 +0530'); each is dated at the end of that day, the latest it can have been.

sources.name: US SEC — press releases
sources.caution: The SEC asks automated readers to identify themselves; it may refuse the collector. The probe will tell.
